svg.text: Vision Action Platform · model → inference → save pipeline
settings · model files → loaded at start → click → FormData → mp4 → (people, 17, 2) → 38-D → (1, 1140) → RandomForest → 200 JSON → DB rows → status · result JSON → screen
① Settings · model files — what is read
settings in the repo + 2 model files kept out of Git (copy into ai_service/models/ as in the README) · last line of each box = who reads it
load settings · model · pose once before any request and check the spec (1,140 · 30 steps · 6 classes · column order)
③ Get the input video — backend/ (Django · Celery)
one click = one AnalysisJob row · an uploaded file or an 8 s IP Webcam clip becomes the mp4 sent to FastAPI
mp4 → YOLO Pose · ByteTrack → (people, 17, 2) → 38-D → 5 s window · (30, 38) → (1, 1140) → RandomForest → action_label per track
⑤ Save · display — Celery saves with the Django ORM, screens read the DB
FastAPI never sees the DB · results live in AnalysisJob 1 ─ N PersonPrediction (analyses/models.py)
⑥ Verification — not a runtime step · docker compose exec django python manage.py test → 51 OK
Celery eager mode · predict_video mocked → runs without Redis · FastAPI · model · no arrows (checks only, changes nothing)
status JSON · result JSON (2 s · max 600 s)
yolo11n-pose.pt YOLO Pose weights (not in Git)
not baked into the image → swap the model only
threading.Lock: one video at a time
server still starts → reason kept in load_error
success → session cookie · redirect to index
camera IP hidden · separate from analysis
role · returns job id right away
log job#N: wait · video · AI · save s (+0900)
business data in PostgreSQL · port private
rewrite with real fps · fail → CameraError
role · get the mp4 to analyze
django saves upload ↔ celery reads it
probe: fps · frames · width · height · duration_sec
unseen within lost_timeout 2 s → None gap
whole visible span → 30 steps, predict once
mean of windows → argmax → action_label · confidence
analyses_analysisjob: 1 row per job · status · video
over 600 s or is_stale → stop with notice
enqueue 503 · stuck job delete · poll 600 s
job#N logs · X-Job-ID · query count · is_uncertain
relays MJPEG then closes · cut at 60 s
model.classes_ in models/ → predict_proba column order → JSON action_label → checked in save_result → PersonPrediction.action_label → screen (a prediction, not ground truth)
arrow text = data format passed · gray dashed arrow = object from another section · failure path
